message: `compose:` does not name a Compose service. A service name uses letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, as in `compose:orders-api`.
`compose:web/ui` does not name a Compose service. A service name uses letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, as in `compose:orders-api`.
`maven:orders$api` does not name a Maven module. Write the module's artifactId, which uses letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, as in `maven:orders-core`.
`npm:Shop-Web` does not name an npm package. Write the `name` from its package.json, in lower case, as in `npm:orders-web` or `npm:@shop/orders-web`.
`npm:@shop` does not name an npm package. Write the `name` from its package.json, in lower case, as in `npm:orders-web` or `npm:@shop/orders-web`.
`class:1Pricing` does not name a class. Write a class name, as in `class:OrderService` or `class:com.shop.orders.OrderService`, or a package and `.*`, as in `class:com.shop.orders.*`.
`class:com..shop` does not name a class. Write a class name, as in `class:OrderService` or `class:com.shop.orders.OrderService`, or a package and `.*`, as in `class:com.shop.orders.*`.
`class:*` does not name a class. Write a class name, as in `class:OrderService` or `class:com.shop.orders.OrderService`, or a package and `.*`, as in `class:com.shop.orders.*`.
